close_reason: Superseded by PKIX-amgn.5 commit c70821b4: cabf_tls_br.rs moved from pkix-lint to pkix-lint-cabf (git mv); pkix-lint-cabf/src/lib.rs declares pub mod cabf_tls_br; pkix-lint/src/lib.rs dropped the module decl (was L219); use crate::{...} rewritten to use pkix_lint::{...} (added Profile + ValidationPolicy to the re-export to avoid pulling pkix-path as a direct dep); pkix-profiles-cabf dropped from pkix-lint/Cargo.toml [dependencies] and [dev-dependencies]; pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs rustdoc updated. Workspace cargo check --all-features clean.
description:
## Why

PKIX-amgn.5 stripping step. After PKIX-amgn.5.1 prepares the destination crate, this bead does the mechanical file relocation.

## What

1. `git mv pkix-lint/src/cabf_tls_br.rs pkix-lint-cabf/src/cabf_tls_br.rs`.
2. In `pkix-lint-cabf/src/lib.rs`, add `pub mod cabf_tls_br;`.
3. In `pkix-lint/src/lib.rs`, drop `pub mod cabf_tls_br;` (currently L219).
4. Inside the moved `cabf_tls_br.rs`, rewrite `use crate::{Lint, LintProfile, LintResult, LintRunner, Scope, Severity, SubjectKind}` → `use pkix_lint::{Lint, LintProfile, LintResult, LintRunner, Scope, Severity, SubjectKind}`.
5. Remove `pkix-profiles-cabf` from `pkix-lint/Cargo.toml`'s `[dependencies]` (currently L29) and `[dev-dependencies]` (currently L45).
6. Update `pkix-lint/src/rfc5280.rs` rustdoc (L19, L21–22) to point at `pkix_lint_cabf::cabf_tls_br` rather than `crate::cabf_tls_br`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] `pkix-lint` compiles cleanly without `cabf_tls_br` (`cargo check -p pkix-lint --all-features`).
- [ ] `pkix-lint-cabf` exposes `pub mod cabf_tls_br` with all six lints + `CabfTlsBrProfile` + `all_lints()` (`cargo check -p pkix-lint-cabf`).
- [ ] `pkix-lint-cabf/Cargo.toml` carries the deps from PKIX-amgn.5.1.

## Out of scope

- Integration tests file move — PKIX-amgn.5.3 (it's coupled with a design decision about test policy).
- README / rustdoc reframe — PKIX-amgn.5.4.
- Version bumps + CHANGELOG — PKIX-amgn.5.5.
- Six framework unit tests in `pkix-lint/src/oscal/catalog.rs` and `pkix-lint/src/oscal/profile.rs` that import `crate::cabf_tls_br::all_lints` — these break in this bead and are resolved in .5.3 (per the design call there).

## Depends on

PKIX-amgn.5.1.
title: Move cabf_tls_br.rs from pkix-lint to pkix-lint-cabf
